spans.s:
वि-जिग्राहयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus.),
wishing to cause to fight or wage war.

विजिग्राहयिषु वि-जिग्राहयिषु, वि-जिघृ-
क्षु. See p. 913, col. 1.

वि-जिघृक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.), wishing to
make war or fight with, determined to encounter or
oppose.

विज् 1. विज्, cl. 7. P. विनक्ति, विवेज, वि-
जिष्यति, अविजीत्, cl. 6. A. (usually with
prep. उद्) विजते, विविजे, विजिष्यते, अविजिष्ट, वि-
जितुम्, to shake, tremble; to be agitated; to tremble
with fear; to fear, be afraid; to be distressed or
afflicted; cl. 3. P. A. (= rt. विच्, with which, as a verb
of the 3rd class in the sense ‘to separate, discrimi-
nate,’ it may be identified, see rt. विच्) वेवेक्ति, वे-
विक्ते, &c., to separate, divide; to separate by the
reason, distinguish, discriminate, judge; to be sepa-
rate, &c.: Pass. विज्यते, Aor. अवेजि: Caus. वेज-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अवीविजत्, to terrify, frighten:
Desid. विविजिषति: Intens. वेविज्यते, वेवेक्ति, to
shake or tremble violently; [cf. probably Gr. ἀΐσσω;
Angl. Sax. wicelian, wince.]

2. विज्, m., Ved., according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
1. 92, 10. विजः = पक्षिणः, ‘birds,’ but according
to modern scholars the meaning is rather ‘dice.’

वीज् वीज् [cf. rt. 1. विज्], cl. 1. A. वीजते,
वीजितुम्, to go; cl. 10. P. वीजयति,
यितुम् (perhaps a Nom. fr. व्यज, q. v.), to fan,
cool by blowing upon or fanning: Pass. वीज्यते, to
be fanned; [cf. Lat. vigeo.]
= उद्-वेजक.)

वीज वीज, अम्, n. (in the older language
frequently written बीज; perhaps fr. rt. जन् with वि;
according to some connected with rt. 1. वी), seed
(of plants &c.), seed-corn, grain; semen virile;
(perhaps also) quicksilver; marrow; any germ, ele-
ment, beginning, cause, source, primary cause or
principle, origin; the germ or origin of any compo-
sition (as of a poem, of the plot of a drama, of a
magical formula, &c.); calculating primary causes,
analysis, algebra; truth, divine truth (as the seed or
cause of being); the mystical letter or syllable which
forms the essential part of the Mantra of any deity;
receptacle, place of deposit; a particular correction
in astronomy; (अस्), m. = वीजक, the citron tree.
—वीज-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘producer of seed,’ epithet
of Śiva.
—वीज-काण्ड-प्ररोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or वीज-
काण्ड-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, springing from a seed or
from the (slip or portion taken from a) stalk.
—वीज-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, producing semen; (त्), n. an aphro-
disiac.
—वीज-कोश or वीज-कोष, अस्, m. a seed-
vessel, the pericarp of a flower; the seed-vessel of
the lotus; (ई), f. a pod, legume.
—वीज-क्रिया, f.
the operation of analysis, elemental or algebraic
solution.
—वीज-गणित, अम्, n. calculation of pri-
mary causes, causal calculus, analysis, algebra; N. of a
treatise on algebra.
—वीज-गर्भ, अस्, m. the plant
Trichosanthes Diœca.
—वीज-गुप्ति, इस्, f. ‘seed-
protection,’ a pod, legume.
—वीज-तस्, ind. from seed,
according to the seed.
—वीज-त्व, अम्, n. the being
an origin or cause, causality.
—वीज-दर्शक, अस्,
m. ‘explainer of the germ or plot of a play,’ a play-
director, stage-manager.
—वीज-धानी, f., N. of a
river.
—वीज-धान्य, अम्, n. coriander.
—वीज-
न्यास, अस्, m. (in dramatic language) laying down
or making known the germ or plot of a play.
—वीज-
पादप, अस्, m. the plant Semecarpus Anacardium
(= भल्लातक).
—वीज-पुर, incorrect for वीज-
पूर.
—वीज-पुरुष, अस्, m. the progenitor of
a tribe or family.
—वीज-पुष्प, अम्, n. common
citron; a thorny plant, Vangueria Spinosa (= म-
रुवक).
—वीज-पुष्पिका, f. a sort of grain, An-
dropogon Saccharatus.
—वीज-पूर or वीज-पूरक,
अस्, m. ‘seed-filling,’ common citron; a variety of
citron, Citrus Medica; (अम्), n. the fruit of the
citron.
—वीज-पूर्ण, अस्, m. ‘seed-filled,’ epithet of
the common citron (= छोलङ्ग); Citrus Medica.
—वीज-पेशिका, f, ‘seed-sheath,’ the scrotum.
—वीज-
प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, yielding seed, sowing seed, &c.;
generating; (अस्), m. a generator.
—वीज-प्रबोध,
अस्, m., N. of a commentary on the Vīja-gaṇita.
—वीज-प्ररोह, अस्, आ, अम्, or वीज-प्ररोहिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, growing from seed.
—वीज-फलक, अस्, m.
the plant Citurs Medica; a citron or lemon.
—वीज-
मति, इस्, f. (in algebra) a mind capable of analysis,
penetration of causes or principles, causal sagacity.
—वीज-मन्त्र, अम्, n. epithet of a mystical syllable
with which a Mantra or magical formula commences.
—वीज-मातृका, f. the pericarp or seed-vessel of
the lotus.
—वीज-मात्र, अम्, n. only as much as
is required for seed, only what is required for the
procreation of offspring or for the preservation of a
family; epithet of the ninth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-
veda.
—वीज-मुक्तावली, f., N. of a work.
—वीज-
यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘seed-offering,’ N. of a particular
allegorical sacrifice or offering.
—वीज-रत्न, अस्, m.
‘having gems of seeds,’ a kind of bean.
—वीज-रुह,
अस्, आ, अम्, growing from seed; (अस्), m. grain,
corn.
—वीज-रेचन, अम्, n. Croton Jamalgota (=
जय-पाल).
—१. वीज-वत्, ind. like seed.
—२. वीज-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing seed, furnished or pro-
vided with seed; provided with grain.
—वीज-व-
पन, अम्, n. the act of sowing seed.
—वीज-वर,
अस्, m. ‘best of grains,’ a kidney-bean, Phaseolus
Radiatus.
—वीज-वाप, अस्, m. a sower of seed;
the act of sowing seed.
—वीज-वापिन्, ई, m. ‘sowing
[]
seed,’ a sower.
—वीज-वाहन, अस्, m. ‘seed-bearer,’
N. of Śiva.
—वीज-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the plant Ter-
minalia Tomentosa.
—वीज-सञ्चय, अस्, m. a heap
or collection of seed or grain.
—वीज-सू, ऊस्, f.
‘bringing forth seed,’ the earth.
—वीज-सेक्तृ, ता,
m. a sprinkler of seed, procreator, progenitor.
—वीज-
हरा or वीज-हारिणी, f. ‘taking away seed,’ epithet
of a witch (a daughter of Duḥsaha).
—वीजा-कृत,
see below.
—वीजाक्षर (˚ज-अक्˚), अम्, n. the first
syllable of a magical formula, the syllable at the
commencement of a Mantra or form of prayer.
—वीजाङ्कुर (˚ज-अङ्˚), अस्, m. a sprout or first
shoot from a seed, seed-shoot, seed-lobe, cotyledon,
seedling; (औ), m. du. seed and shoot, seed and
blade.
—वीजाङ्कुर-वत्, ind. (in phil.) like the
(continuous succession of) seed and shoot.
—वीजा-
ढ्य (˚ज-आढ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in seed; (अस्),
m. = वीज-पूर.
—वीजाध्यक्ष (˚ज-अध्˚), अस्,
m. ‘presiding over seed,’ epithet of Śiva.
—वीजापहा-
रिणी (˚ज-अप्˚), f. = वीज-हरा.
—वीजाभिधान
(˚ज-अभ्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
—वीजाम्ल
(˚ज-अम्˚), अम्, n. = वृक्षाम्ल.
—वीजार्णव-
तन्त्र (˚ज-अर्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
—वीजाश्व (˚ज-अश्˚), अस्, m. ‘seed-horse,’ an entire
horse, stallion.
—वीजोत्कृष्ट (˚ज-उत्˚), अम्, n.
good seed.
—वीजोदक (˚ज-उद्˚), अम्, n. ‘seed-
water, grain-like water,’ hail.
—वीजोप्ति (˚ज-उप्˚),
इस्, f. sowing seed.
—वीजोप्ति-चक्र, अम्, n. a kind
of astrological diagram shaped like a serpent for
indicating good or bad luck following on the sowing
of seed.
—वीजोप्ति-विधि, इस्, m. the manner of sow-
ing seed.

वीजा, ind. by or with seed, sowing with seed.
—वीजा-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to sow with seed,
sow; to harrow over after sowing.
—वीजा-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, sown with seed, sown; harrowed or ploughed
over after sowing.
विजितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be apprehended or feared.

विजितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what separates or
divides, separating, &c.; (ता), m. a discriminator,
distinguisher, judge; a partner, co-heir.

विजग्ध वि-जग्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt. 1. जक्ष्),
eaten up, devoured.

विजटीकृ वि-जटी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्-
तुम्, to comb out braided or matted hair.

विजन् वि-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to
be born or produced; to bear young, generate, en-
gender, bring forth, produce; to be transformed.

वि-जनन, अम्, n. the act of generating or bearing
young, bringing forth, procreation, birth, delivery.

वि-जनित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought forth, engendered,
begotten, born, produced.

वि-जन्मन्, अ, n. separate birth, birth in general;
(आ, आ, अ), born illegitimately, bastard; (आ), m. a
bastard, illegitimate child, the son of an outcast or
of a degraded Vaiśya.

वि-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born separately; base born,
of mixed origin; generated; born; transformed;
(आ), f. a woman who has borne children, a mother,
matron.
विजात वि-जात, वि-जाति. See above.

वि-जाति, इस्, f. different origin or birth; different
species; different caste or tribe or kind.

वि-जामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. variously born, manifold,
(Sāy. = वि-जन्मन्.)
विजामन् वि-जामन्. See above.

वि-जायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being born or pro-
duced; generating, producing offspring.

वि-जयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering, victorious,
triumphant.

वि-जावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. variously productive,
prolific, widely-spreading.

विज्जन विज्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c.
mixed with rice-water or gruel.

वीजन, अम्, n. fanning, the being fanned; a fan
[cf. व्यजन]; a thing, substance; (अस्), m. a sort
of pheasant; the ruddy goose.

विजपिल विजपिल, अम्, n. (etymology
doubtful), mud (= पङ्क).
विजय वि-जय, विजयिन्, &c. See below.

वि-जय, अस्, m. conquest, victory, triumph, over-
coming, defeating, overpowering, excelling; a divine
car, chariot of the gods; N. of Arjuna; of Yama;
of a son of Cuñcu; of a son of Jaya; of a son of
Sañjaya; of a son of Jayad-ratha; of a king of the
Āndhra race; of the father of the twenty-first Jina;
of one of the persons named Śukla-Balas by the
Jainas [cf. बल]; of the founder of Buddhist
civilisation in Ceylon; of a particular auspicious
period; of the first year of Jupiter's cycle; (आ),
f., N. of the goddess Durgā; of one of her
female attendants; of one of the wives of Yama;
of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kṛśāśva; of
various plants, hemp, Cannabis Sativa, or the tops
of the plant used as a narcotic; yellow myrobalan,
Terminalia Chebula; orris root; N. of a particular
Tithi or lunar day (the third, eighth, or thirteenth
[]
of a fortnight); of a festival in honour of Durgā (on
the tenth day of the light half of the month Āśvina,
when the image of Durgā is cast into the water);
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
—विजय-कुञ्जर, अस्,
m. a royal or war elephant (which carries a standard).
—विजय-च्छन्द, अस्, m. a kind of necklace, one
of 500 rows or strings.
—विजय-डिण्डिम, अस्, m.
‘drum of victory,’ a large military drum.
—विजय-
तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—विजय-दशमी,
f. the tenth day of the light half of the month
Āśvina, the day of the Daśa-harā, &c.
—विजय-
नगर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—विजय-नन्दन,
अस्, m., N. of a sovereign of the race of Ikṣvāku.
—विजय-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having victory for a
result.
—विजय-मर्दल, अस्, m. ‘drum of victory,’
a large military drum.
—विजय-राम, अस्, m. a
proper N.
—विजय-लक्ष्मी, ईस्, f., N. of the
mother of Veṅkaṭa.
—विजय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-
sessing victory, triumphant.
—विजय-सिद्धि, इस्, f.
accomplishment of victory, success.
—विजयाभिनन्-
दन (˚य-अभ्˚), अस्, m., N. of a great warrior yet
to arise and to be the founder of an era.
—विजया-
भ्युपाय (˚य-अभ्˚), अस्, m. means of victory.
—विजयार्थम् (˚य-अर्˚), ind. on account of vic-
tory, for victory.
—विजयार्थिन् (˚य-अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ,
seeking victory, desirous of conquest.
—विजया-सप्-
तमी, f. the seventh day of the light half of a month
falling on a Sunday.
—विजयेश (˚य-ईश), अस्, m.
‘lord of victory,’ epithet of Śiva.
—विजयोत्सव
(˚य-उत्˚), अस्, m. ‘victory-festival,’ N. of a festival
in honour of Viṣṇu celebrated on the tenth day of the
light half of the month Āśvina (= विजय-दशमी).
वि-जय; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), conquering, victorious.

विजयिन विजयिन, अस्, आ, अम्, sauce mixed
with the water of boiled rice; [cf. विजल.]

विजर वि-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from decay,
fresh, young; (अम्), n. a stalk.

विजल विजल, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c.
mixed with rice-water or gruel (= विजिन, पिच्छिल).

वीजल, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with seed or grain,
seedy.

विजल्प् वि-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्पितुम्,
to speak foolishly, chatter, talk, speak (in general).
वि-जल्प, अस्, m. speech, talk, idle or foolish talk.

वि-जल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken foolishly, spoken
or talked about.
विजानत् वि-जानत्. See under वि-ज्ञा.

वि-जानत्, अन्, अती, अत्, distinguishing, understand-
ing, knowing, recognising, possessing various or
extended knowledge, wise, considerate; (अन्), m. a
wise man, sage.

विजामातृ वि-जामातृ, ता, m., Ved. an in-
ferior daughter's husband, defective son-in-law (ex-
plained by Yāska as ‘one who has not all the neces-
sary qualifications,’ see Nirukta
VI. 9

, where it is also
said that the people of the south always speak of
this word as denoting ‘a man who has purchased his
wife’).

विजि वि-जि, cl. 1. A. -जयते (rarely P. -ज-
यति), -जेतुम्, to conquer, vanquish, be victorious,
overcome, defeat, overpower; to win or acquire by
conquest; to contend victoriously with (with inst.);
to surpass, excel: Caus. -जापयति, -यितुम् (anom.
Aor. अजीजयत्), to cause to conquer; to conquer:
Desid. -जिगीषति, to wish to conquer; to attack.

वि-जयन्त, अस्, m. ‘the victorious,’ epithet of
Indra.

विजयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, conquering, victorious, trium-
phant; (ई), m. a conqueror.

वि-जिगीष, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of victory, wishing
to overcome or conquer; emulous; (आ), f. a desire
to conquer or overcome or subdue, wish to surpass,
desire to excel, competition, emulation, ambition.
—विजिगीषा-विवर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of am-
bition.

वि-जिगीषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing or striving to
conquer.

वि-जिगीषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, desirous to conquer or over-
come, desirous of victory.

वि-जिगीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of victory or con-
quest, desirous to overcome or surpass, emulative,
emulous, ambitious; (उस्), m. a warrior; an invader,
antagonist; a disputant; an opponent.

वि-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered, subdued, defeated,
won, gained.
—विजित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who
has conquered.
—विजितात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ,
one who has conquered himself, self-subdued.
—वि-
जिताश्व (˚त-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a son of Pṛthu.
—विजितासन (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, indifferent about
a seat.
—विजितेन्द्रिय (˚त-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
the organs of sense or passions subdued.
1. वीजित, अस्, आ, अम्, fanned, cooled by fanning.

2. वीजित, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with seed, sown with,
having for seed.

वि-जिति, इस्, f. conquest, victory, triumphing over,
vanquishing; victory over various enemies.
वि-जित्य, ind. having conquered, having won.

वि-जेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, victorious, a victor, conqueror,
gainer, winner, (पुरां विजेतृ, ‘conqueror of towns,’
an epithet of Śiva.)

विजिन विजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce
&c. mixed with rice-water or gruel; [cf. विजल.]
विजिल or विजिविल = विजिन above.

विज्जिल, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c. mixed with
rice-gruel.

विजिहीर्षा वि-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of वि-
हृ), wish or intention to roam about or take one's
pleasure.

वि-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or seeking to
roam about or sport.

विजिह्म वि-जिह्म, अस्, आ, अम्, curved, bent;
crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved.
[]
—विजिह्म-ता, f. or विजिह्म-त्व, अम्, n. crooked-
ness, dishonesty, craftiness.

विजीव् वि-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -जीवितुम्, to
revive, return to life.
विजुल विजुल, अस्, m. the silk-cotton tree.

विजृम्भ् वि-जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. -जृम्भते, -जृम्-
भितुम्, to yawn, gape; to open (intrans.), unfold,
expand, become expanded or developed or exhibited,
spread out, blossom; to extend; to spring open, spring
back (as a bow); to become displayed, break forth
or out, appear, rise; to display activity or energy,
exhibit courage, &c.

वि-जृम्भण, अम्, n. yawning, gaping; expand-
ing, unfolding, displaying, exhibiting, extending;
blossoming, budding; pastime, sport (especially
amorous).

विजेह् वि-जेह्, cl. 1. A. -जेहते, -जेहितुम्, to
open the mouth.

वि-जेहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. opening wide;
darting forth, (Sāy. = प्रक्षिपत्.)

विजोषस् वि-जोषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. dis-
united, estranged from each other, no longer friends.
विज्जाका विज्जाका, f., N. of a female poet.

वीजक, अम्, n. seed; = वीज above (at the end of
comps.); (अस्), m. common citron, Citrus Medica
(= मातुलङ्ग); a citron or lemon; Terminalia
Tomentosa (= पीत-शाल); the position of the arm
of a child at birth; N. of a poet.

विज्जूलिका विज्जूलिका, f., N. of a kind of
plant (= जतुका).
विज्ञ वि-ज्ञ. See below.

वि-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing, intelligent; wise,
learned; proficient, conversant, clever, experienced,
skilful, prudent, discreet; (अस्), m. a wise man.
—विज्ञ-ता, f. or विज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. intelligence,
wisdom, learning, skill, cleverness.
—विज्ञ-बुद्धि,
इस्, f. Indian spikenard (= जटा-मांसी).

विज्ञा वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते,
ज्ञातुम्, to distinguish, discern, understand, observe,
perceive, know, recognise, know thoroughly or well,
have a right knowledge of; to be familiar with; to
find out, investigate, inquire, ascertain, learn, learn
from (with gen.); to hear, to consider as; to explain;
to become wise or learned (Manu
IV. 20

): Caus.
-ज्ञपयति and -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to make known,
declare, report, communicate, announce to any one
(acc.); to make any one understand, apprise, teach,
instruct; to make a representation or request (in a
respectful manner), ask, beg; to inform any one of
anything (with two acc.): Desid. -जिज्ञासति, to wish
to understand or know, &c.

वि-जिज्ञासा, f. a desire of knowing distinctly, wish
to prove or try.

वि-ज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, reported, re-
presented; apprised, respectfully informed or told.

वि-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. information, representation, re-
spectful statement or communication; a report, an-
nouncement.

वि-ज्ञाप्ति, इस्, f. representing, informing; respectful
communication or representation.

वि-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, discerned, understood, known,
perceived; celebrated, famous, notorious.
—विज्ञा-
तार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who is acquainted
with any matter or the true state of a case.

वि-ज्ञातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who knows or under-
stands, an experienced person.

वि-ज्ञान, अम्, n. the act of distinguishing or per-
[]
ceiving or recognising, discerning, understanding,
comprehending, distinction, intelligence, knowledge,
science, learning, worldly knowledge of any kind
(including all subjects except that understanding of
the true nature of God or Brahma which is acquirable
only by abstract meditation and the study of the
Vedas), wisdom; business, employment; music.
—विज्ञान-कन्द, अस्, m. a proper N.
—विज्ञान-
कौमुदी, f., N. of a Buddhist woman.
—विज्ञान-
पाद, अस्, m. (see पाद), an epithet of Vyāsa.
—वि-
ज्ञान-भिक्षु, उस्, m., N. of the author of the Yoga-
sāra-saṅgraha, the Yoga-vārttika, the Sāṅkhya-sāra,
and the Brahmādarśa.
—विज्ञान-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of knowledge or intelligence, all knowledge,
intellectual (said of the first or innermost of the
several sheaths of the soul).
—विज्ञानमय-कोष,
अस्, m. the sheath consisting of intelligence, the in-
telligent sheath (of the soul, according to the Vedānta
philosophy) or that sheath which is caused by the
understanding being associated with the organs of
perception.
—विज्ञान-मातृक, अस्, m. ‘parent of
knowledge,’ an epithet of Buddha.
—विज्ञान-ललित,
N. of a work.
—विज्ञान-वाद, अस्, m. the theory
of Vi-jñāna, ideal theory.
—विज्ञानेश्वर (˚न-
ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘master of knowledge,’ N. of the author
of the Mitākṣarā commentary.

विज्ञानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, learned, well-informed,
clever, skilful, proficient, conversant.

वि-ज्ञापक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), who or
what makes known or apprises, making known,
giving information; (अस्), m. an informant; an
instructor.

वि-ज्ञापन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of making known
or acquainting, teaching; representing, informing;
information, instruction; respectful communication or
representation.

वि-ज्ञापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made known or
represented, to be apprised.

वि-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, apprised, informed, in-
structed; respectfully told or represented.

वि-ज्ञाय, ind. having known or perceived, having
understood, having ascertained, having recognised.

वि-ज्ञेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be perceived or known
or understood; cognizable, intelligible, comprehen-
sible, discernible, recognizable.

विज्वर वि-ज्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fever
or pain; free from distress; exempt from decay.
वीज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being fanned, fanned.

वीजिक, अस्, आ, अम्, seedy, abounding in seeds; see
Gaṇa Kumud-ādi to Pāṇ.

वीजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or possessing seed, bearing
seed, seedy; being of the race or blood of (at the
end of a comp., cf. राज-व्˚); (ई), m. a real proge-
nitor (as opposed to क्षेत्रिन्, the nominal father or
merely the husband of a woman, Manu
IX. 51

sq.);
a procreator, father (in general); the sun.
वि-ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unstrung; [cf. स-ज्य.]
वि-जेष, अस्, m., Ved. victory, conquest.
विजेष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. causing victory.
